concept: S3 Object Lock: compliance mode (WORM, not even root can delete)
tests: How to guarantee nobody, including administrators, can delete or modify S3 logs during the retention period.
expected: S3 Object Lock in compliance mode — WORM, retention can't be removed even by root. Triggers: "cannot be deleted or altered by anyone, including administrators", "fixed retention period", "regulated".
why_not: Versioning allows deleting versions; an administrator can change a bucket policy; lifecycle expiration actually deletes objects. (Governance mode — privileged users can bypass it.)
